propositions: Six files in src/rebar are at or near the 800-LOC hard module-size cap with no headroom for future edits, causing CI failures on any addition including comments
Splits must follow existing logical and architectural boundaries in the call graph rather than mechanical line carving, and must create files of 100-500 LOC to avoid thin shims
The module-size-limit.txt configuration is locked and cannot be raised; all headroom must be restored by refactoring the in-scope files
Behavior-preserving splits require no test modifications unless forced by symbol moves; test changes indicate the wrong seam was chosen
Registry and import allowlists keyed to moved symbols must be updated in the same commit to avoid stale reference failures
The census of near-cap files has been invalidated by 45 merged changes; current LOC measurements must be re-run against origin/main before selecting extraction targets
